message.content:
Wikipedia API requires a User-Agent header or we can use `web_search` / `web_fetch`.
Let's search Wikipedia specifically or fetch the Wikipedia page using `web_search` or curl with user-agent via `run_command`.

Let's test running curl with a User-Agent header via `run_command`.```python
cmd = 'curl -s -A "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64)" "https://en.wikipedia.org/w/api.php?action=query&prop=revisions&rvprop=content&format=json&titles=Moon" | python3 -c "import sys, json, re; data=json.load(sys.stdin); wt=list(data[\'query\'][\'pages\'].values())[0][\'revisions\'][0][\'*\']; print(\'\\n\'.join([line for line in wt.splitlines() if \'perigee\' in line.lower() or \'orbit\' in line.lower()][:20]))"'
out = await run_command(cmd)
print(out)
```
